: BIH LM Senologie Brustwand-Operation

: https://www.senologie.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/senologie-operation : 0.10.0
Draft : Senologie_Operation

Operationen im Rahmen der BIH-Spezifikation des Moduls Senologie. Erbt Intention, PräoperativeMarkierung und IntraoperativesImaging von MII Onko Mamma Operation.

Usages:

  • Use this Profil: Senologie Meldungs-Bundle
  • Examples for this Profil: Procedure/Example-Operation-BET, Procedure/Example-Operation-SLNB, Procedure/Fall1-Operation-BET, Procedure/Fall1-Operation-SLNB... , Procedure/Fall10-Operation-Mastektomie-Links, Procedure/Fall10-Operation-Mastektomie-Rechts, Procedure/Fall10-Operation-SLNB, Procedure/Fall10-Rekonstruktion-Links, Procedure/Fall10-Rekonstruktion-Rechts, Procedure/Fall12-Operation-Nachresektion, Procedure/Fall13-Operation-BET-Links, Procedure/Fall13-Operation-Mastektomie-Rechts, Procedure/Fall14-Operation-BET, Procedure/Fall2-Operation-Axilladissektion, Procedure/Fall2-Operation-Mastektomie, Procedure/Fall3-Operation-Axilladissektion, Procedure/Fall3-Operation-Mastektomie, Procedure/Fall4-Operation-BET, Procedure/Fall4-Operation-SLNB, Procedure/Fall5-Operation-BET, Procedure/Fall5-Operation-SLNB, Procedure/Fall6-Operation-BET, Procedure/Fall7-Operation-BET, Procedure/Fall7-Operation-SLNB, Procedure/Fall8-Operation-Mastektomie, Procedure/Fall8-Operation-SLNB, Procedure/Fall9-Operation-Axilladissektion and Procedure/Fall9-Operation-BET
